messages.content: "Can you help me calculate the compound interest for my savings? I initially invested $5000 as the principal amount. The bank offers an annual interest rate of 2.5%. I plan to keep my money in the bank for 10 years. Also, the interest is compounded quarterly, so it's compounded 4 times in a year. Can you calculate the compound interest I would get for the first 2 years, first 3 years and first 5 years?"

function.name: calculate_compound_interest
function.description: Calculate compound interest for an initial principal amount. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

principal.description: The principal amount that the interest is applied to.

rate.description: The annual interest rate. Enter as a decimal. E.g, 5% is 0.05 This is a float type value.

time.description: The time the money is invested for in years.

n.description: The number of times that interest is compounded per time period. Default is 1.

message.content:
Sure!  
Below is the breakdown of what your \$5 000 will grow to when the bank compounds **quarterly** (four times a year) at an annual nominal rate of **2.5 %**, and then the interest earned for the requested horizons.

| Horizon | Formula used | Calculation |
|---------|--------------|-------------|
| First 2 years | \(A_{2}=P\,(1+\frac{r}{n})^{\,n\times 2}\) | \(\displaystyle 5000\bigl(1+\tfrac{0.025}{4}\bigr)^{8}
      =5000(1.00625)^{8}= \$5\,255.54\) |
| Interest earned (after 2 yrs) | \(I_{2}=A_{2}-P\) | \(\$5\,255.54-\$5\,000=\boxed{\$255.54}\) |

---

| Horizon | Formula used | Calculation |
|---------|--------------|-------------|
| First 3 years | \(A_{3}=P\,(1+\frac{r}{n})^{\,n\times 3}\) | \(\displaystyle 5000(1.00625)^{12}
      =\$5\,388.17\) |
| Interest earned (after 3 yrs) | \(I_{3}=A_{3}-P\) | \(\$5\,388.17-\$5\,000=\boxed{\$388.17}\) |

---

| Horizon | Formula used | Calculation |
|---------|--------------|-------------|
| First 5 years | \(A_{5}=P\,(1+\frac{r}{n})^{\,n\times 5}\) | \(\displaystyle 5000(1.00625)^{20}
      =\$5\,663.55\) |
| Interest earned (after 5 yrs) | \(I_{5}=A_{5}-P\) | \(\$5\,663.55-\$5\,000=\boxed{\$663.55}\) |

### Quick recap

| Years | Final balance | Total interest earned |
|-------|---------------|------------------------|
| 2     | \$5 255.54    | **\$255.54**           |
| 3     | \$5 388.17    | **\$388.17**           |
| 5     | \$5 663.55    | **\$663.55**           |

These figures assume no additional deposits or withdrawals during those periods—just the original \$5 000 growing under the stated terms. If you'd like to see the effect of adding periodic contributions or changing the compounding frequency, let me know!
